name: How should I prepare my bathroom for countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my bathroom for countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for bathroom countertop installation, clear the area by removing all personal items from the countertop and inside the vanity cabinets. Ensure a clear path for installers to bring in materials. If possible, disconnect and remove the sink and faucet yourself, or arrange for a plumber to do so beforehand. Protecting your bathroom floor and surrounding areas with drop cloths is also a good practice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all items from the countertop and vanity, ensure a clear path for installers, and arrange for sink/faucet disconnection. Protect floors from dust and debris.
